text: Plan amendment 2026-11-16 (branch claude/plan-measurement-contract-20261116 @eaea4c207): a DL3 source binding carries the contract's reference meaning (single, joint, broad or alternative), so a summary of an episode is not stored as a citation of every row in it. An atom with no source binding keeps its explicit outcome (external, unresolved, not assessed). A fidelity grade is conditional on the hypothesis it was assessed against.
